headline.label: of NASA lander contracts ended on their side
how: IM-1 Odysseus $122M + IM-2 Athena $50M: NASA CLPS task-order values as of Feb 2024.
Both touched down, then tipped. IM-2 came to rest inside a crater near Mons Mouton.
Peregrine ($108M) is left out: it never tried to land.

NASA release on IM-2 (on its side, inside a crater)

headline.label: for a 10-person field week on Earth
how: Lodging and meals only, at US federal per-diem rates. No airfare, vehicles, gear or salaries.
Even at 10× that, it is about 0.25% of the smaller of the two contracts above.
No published cost found for NASA terrain/landing field campaigns (Desert RATS, JETT, Mars 2020 Lander Vision System field tests, Flight Opportunities terrain-navigation flights).

sources.name: GSA FY2026 per diem bulletin FTR 26-01 (standard CONUS rate)

headline.label: less per team trip by flying to the nearest top-3 match
how: From Calgary, 10 people, round trip. Average over all 27 region × hazard rehearsals: nearest of our top 3 matches vs the farthest.
Nearest averages 15.1 t, farthest 24.0 t. The nearest is also the #1 match in 8 of 27; otherwise you trade a little fit for less travel.
Straight-line distance (real routes emit more). Includes contrail warming (radiative forcing); without it, multiply by 0.59.

headline.label: matched sites are open ground, not forest or wetland
how: Trees ≤ 10% and wetland ≤ 10% of the 15 km site (ESA WorldCover 2021). Median tree cover: 0%.
Our filter keeps trees out so the elevation model sees bare ground; the low footprint is a side effect.
Protected areas are not checked. Check protectedplanet.net and local permits first.
headline.formula: count(tree ≤ 0.10 and wetland + mangrove ≤ 0.10) over sites in any top 3

environment.filter_rule: DSM-safe screen (pipeline/earth/screen.py, windows.py): tree <= 10%, built <= 5%, crop <= 20%, water <= 20%, wetland + mangrove <= 10%, snow < 30% of the 15 km core.
environment.filter_purpose: The rule exists so the 30 m surface model measures ground, not canopy. Steering field teams away from forests and wetlands is a side effect, not its design goal.
environment.protected_areas: Not checked. earth_sites.json has no protected-area flag; check the World Database on Protected Areas (https://www.protectedplanet.net/) and local permits before any visit.
